title: Diagnosis: a clear support report and a verified correction
goal: Explain the 1441-minute refusal, prepare a safe reproduction and confirm valid writing still works.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 5; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: “Does not save” is the start of an observation, not a diagnosis. A reader may be denied a valid value by permissions; an administrator is denied 1441 by the range rule. Compare role and input separately and check what remains saved afterwards.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The worked example uses its own 30/45=75 set. New independent work continues different own 40/25=65 from A5. Do not compare them as one database. Run permission, restoration and upgrade exercises only in a new isolated copy; preserve the original, DT/CFand previous work. Nexus stores the lesson and your note; it does not change external1Croles or data.

sections.title: Separate symptom from hypothesis
paragraphs: “R1 does not save after−1” is an observation;“the infobase is broken” is a hypothesis. Record expectation, safe reproduction steps, version and outcome. Reproduce on a synthetic copy. Do not attach real data publicly when the issue occurs only there; prepare a minimal sanitized example and agree on access separately.

Start with an observation: in my training copy, a request with valid references rejects 1441 minutes and accepts 45. This is more precise than claiming the database is broken. Record program, version, window, action and expected 0..1440 range. Use own synthetic identities; do not attach real databases or screenshots containing other people’s information.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Not every refusal is a program defect.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Open an own 45-minute request as the teaching administrator and record number/date/references/version. Retain older work. Expected: Own saved 45 request identified.

Step 2. Enter 1441 and attempt writing. Read the duration message, retain its safe text and return the open form to 45. Keep validation enabled. Expected: Invalid input rejected with an understood reason.
Step 3. Do not save 1441. Reopen and verify stored 45 plus references/other fields. Expected: Previous 45 and other values retained.

Step 4. Record case ID, time/versions, role, own copy, input 1441, expected refusal, observed message, retained 45 and the valid control. Remove personal/license data and secrets. Expected: A minimal report exists without transferring the base.

Step 5. Repeat valid 45, writing and rereading. State that normal input validation was confirmed without a program fix. Preserve original/new cases separately for an actual defect. Expected: Positive control works; negative case preserves state.

sections.title: Classification narrows diagnosis
paragraphs: Distinguish business-rule rejection, permission denial, configuration defect, environment unavailability and persistence failure. A generic “error” does not prescribe a fix. Compare valid and invalid inputs and inspect state. Do not change role, platform and data simultaneously: the cause of improvement becomes unknowable.

Permission refusal and input validation are different. The reader should not write even valid 31; the administrator should write 45 but be refused 1441. Compare role and input separately. Changing privileges, platform and data simultaneously destroys causal interpretation. Correct clear input errors rather than disabling object validation.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: A reader cannot save 41 and an administrator cannot save 1441. Must both have the same cause?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. First check permitted reading and a valid write for the role; separately test an out-of 0..1440 input as administrator. Reread state after refusal. Full permissions or disabling validation do not correct invalid input.

sections.title: Provide the minimum sufficient package
paragraphs: Include case ID, time, versions, expected/actual, safe message excerpt and control total. Exclude passwords, tokens, full databases and third-party configurations. Review screenshots before sharing. Restrict technical logs; publish only necessary classification and a synthetic example.

A useful report includes case ID, time, platform/configuration, own copy, role, safe steps, expectation, observation, state after refusal and completed controls. Exclude passwords, tokens, licenses, full databases and third-party configurations. Share only the relevant safe message, not arbitrary full-screen or raw-log contents.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Use the second worked case to identify the unsafe or unproved condition. Never perform destructive restoration over existing work.
Compare actual input with the rule and run a valid control.

sections.title: Bound independent repairs
paragraphs: An operator may correct input under a clear rule, but must not run unknown processors or mass cleanup. Preserve work and contact the responsible role. After a fix, repeat the original case and a nearby positive control. Closing the ticket without retesting does not prove the issue disappeared or data survived.

Close the issue by repeating the original case and a valid control. After refusing 1441, this saved request remains 45. Valid changes should persist on rereading. Correcting learner input differs from fixing a program defect: the former needs no configuration change; the latter needs its own revised work/test while preserving the source.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: As training administrator open the 50-minute request in the copy after your backup exercise. Record its own number and fields. Attempt 1441, read the range message, return the draft to 50 and save the valid value. Reread 50 and other fields. Write a short case: version, role, copy, step, expectation, observation and state after refusal. Compare with the separate denial of reader 40→41. Do not change roles or validation to save 1441; do not send the full infobase or private log.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.
